source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned patch adds "title should be correct" to the document.title assertion used outside macOS. The macOS branch still compares titlebar-title-label.value with expectedTitle using only two Assert.equal arguments in the fixed accepted source. Add a nonempty expected-behavior message to that branch too, for example "The macOS title label should match the loaded message title." Preserve each platform’s title surface and expected value. This finding concerns a missing assertion message, not a missing should alone, and does not claim a native-platform test ran.
title: The standalone title check needs an assertion message on each platform branch
